status: historical evidence; descriptive; no causal or counterfactual claim

definitions.ADMIN_REFRESH_ONLY: PR whose changed files are all generated handoff/status/evidence carriers (path list in reproduce_drift_audit.py: ADMIN)
definitions.REPAIR_OF_REFRESH_DEFECT: PR touching src/ or tests/ whose title names refresh/handoff/successor/settle/post-merge/freshness (heuristic)
definitions.PRODUCT_PLUS_HANDOFF: PR with generated carriers plus other files
definitions.refresh_chain: per product commit on main: directly following refresh-only commits before the next non-refresh commit
definitions.ci_minutes_wallclock: sum of (updated_at - run_started_at) of GitHub Actions runs on the PR head SHA; not billed minutes
definitions.verified_elapsed_calendar_days: first date in consumer verified_by minus consumer first_observed; calendar days, not working time

consumer_head_check.note: ledger unchanged at consumer HEAD on 2026-10-16

pr_overhead_oct_01_15.note: reproduces the issue's title analysis (83/166) and shows that all 83 title matches are ADMIN_REFRESH_ONLY by diff

refresh_chains_main.definition: per product commit on main: directly following refresh-only commits before the next non-refresh commit; chain_3plus means three or more
refresh_chains_main.note: chains of 2 or more indicate an extra refresh round after one product change; May predates the refresh mechanism

quality_proxies.note: no revert commits on main; fix-like PR titles are not a defect rate and are not reported as code quality

not_measurable: persistent drift rate per completed work cycle (no complete cycle denominator, no invocation ledger)
stale_escaped / stale_blocked / unnecessary_refresh per handoff attempt (no run receipts for most of the history)
recovery time, tokens and human interventions per recovered case (no timestamps or budgets recorded)
net productivity or code-quality effect of the Kit (no comparison group; A/B/C experiment not run)
